name: Uncommon AddinUtil.EXE CommandLine Execution
description: Detects execution of the Add-In deployment cache updating utility (AddInutil.exe) with uncommon Addinroot or Pipelineroot paths. An adversary may execute AddinUtil.exe with uncommon Addinroot/Pipelineroot paths that point to the adversaries Addins.Store payload.
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:*\\addinutil.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:AddInUtil.exe) AND (process.command_line:(*\-AddInRoot\:* OR *\-PipelineRoot\:*))) AND (NOT (process.command_line:(*\-AddInRoot\:\"C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Common\ Files\\Microsoft\ Shared\\VSTA* OR *\-AddInRoot\:C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Common\ Files\\Microsoft\ Shared\\VSTA* OR *\-PipelineRoot\:\"C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Common\ Files\\Microsoft\ Shared\\VSTA* OR *\-PipelineRoot\:C\:\\Program\ Files\ \(x86\)\\Common\ Files\\Microsoft\ Shared\\VSTA*)))
